entities.summary: Charles Joseph Fleischmann is an American attorney and politician who has been the U.S. representative for Tennessee's 3rd congressional district since 2011. The district is based in Chattanooga and includes a large part of East Tennessee, including Oak Ridge. He is a member of the Republican Party. Chuck Fleischmann was a legal figures from Manhattan (b. 1962-10-11, Manhattan). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
